About the Doctor

Pioneer in Advanced Hernia & Laparoscopic Surgery

Dr. Kumar is a leading expert in advanced abdominal hernia surgery, with extensive expertise in techniques such as eTEP, TEP, TAPP, TAR, IPOM and complex Abdominal Wall Reconstruction (AWR).

A graduate of Stanley Medical College and a Member of the Royal College of Surgeons of England, he is a pioneer in advanced minimally invasive hernia surgery in Chennai.

MBBS, MS Surgery
MRCS England
FALS Hernia & Robotic
FMAS, FIAGES
